title: Passage drill (Sections B and C)
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y11 lesson 55 (Pupil PDF worksheet: passage drill (Sections B and C))
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

parts.text: Point 1: Allah is One (112:1). Develop: so worship is for Him alone. Point 2: none is equal to Him (112:4). Develop: Muslims reject any idea of Allah being like creation.
Teacher does 62:9-11: 'It teaches that Jumu'ah must take priority over trade. I would use it in a 3.2 answer on the importance of Jumu'ah.'

questions.q: Explain what 112:1-4 teaches about Allah. (6 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Allah is One; as-Samad, all depend on Him; He has no child or parent; nothing is equal to Him; each developed with meaning and significance.
questions.model: Point 1: Allah is One (112:1). Develop: so worship is for Him alone. Point 2: none is equal to Him (112:4). Develop: Muslims reject any idea of Allah being like creation.

questions.q: Passage drill on the pupil PDF: write every Section B and C passage from memory, check, then choose three and write 'what it teaches' and 'how I would use it' in the portal response box. Start: 'Passage ... teaches that ...'
questions.a: All passages recalled; three applied accurately to likely questions
questions.model: Teacher does 62:9-11: 'It teaches that Jumu'ah must take priority over trade. I would use it in a 3.2 answer on the importance of Jumu'ah.'

questions.q: write a one-line judgement using 2:183 for a 12-mark statement on fasting.
questions.a: For example: fasting is compulsory (2:183), but its purpose, taqwa, matters more than the rule alone
